title: Crashes and lags
body: I’m using this app on a m2 iPad Air. After using it for more than 30 minutes the iPad would start to warm up and the app itself would start to lag making the note taking process a nightmare. And if you power yourself through that the app would crash and you will loose some of that work that you wrote with all the previous said challenges.
